records.object: Uniaxial-stress entropy-change magnitude ≈ 1 J kg−1 K−1
records.quote: We predict the existence of large barocaloric effects above room temperature in the thermoelectric fast-ion conductor Cu2Se by using classical molecular dynamics simulations and first-principles computational methods.
